input.quote: Customer may terminate this Agreement or any Order Form for convenience, in whole or in part, upon thirty days' prior written notice to Vendor.
input.rationale: Section 9.4 gives us a 30-day convenience right with a pro-rata refund of prepaid Fees and no early-termination penalty, and expressly denies Vendor any matching right during a committed term — our preferred position. Section 2.1's take-or-pay language ("without reduction or termination rights") cuts against this and is addressed under MINCOMMIT to avoid double-counting.
